description: Ask SharedMemory to make a decision or answer a question based on all stored knowledge. Returns an answer with confidence score, supporting evidence, applicable procedures, and conflict detection. Use this when you need a definitive answer about 'what should we do?' or 'how do we handle X?'

fast.description: Skip LLM synthesis for faster response (returns raw source instead)

question.description: The question or situation to decide on (e.g. 'How do we handle refunds?' or 'What's the deployment process?')

volume_id.description: Volume ID. Uses default if not set.

name: decide
